# Kenneth Nathanael

> Designer in Bengaluru, India, with 10+ years in brands, campaigns, video and web. Design Lead at Milestone Technologies. Open to roles and freelance.

The site is built as a macOS-style desktop (best on a laptop); phones get a one-page version. Every project also has a plain page at /work/<slug>.

## Work

- [Best Work](https://kennethnathanael.com/work/best-work): the pieces to see first, picked from every project
- [Milestone Technologies](https://kennethnathanael.com/work/milestone): brand rollout and campaigns as Design Lead of the in-house creative studio
- [Fluid AI](https://kennethnathanael.com/work/fluid-ai): brand identity, UI and merchandise for a Web3 liquidity platform
- [Marriott Hotels](https://kennethnathanael.com/work/marriott): artwork and environmental graphics for Marriott, Sheraton and Aloft
- [LeBron James](https://kennethnathanael.com/work/lebron-nike): a personal concept for an athlete-led product page (not affiliated with Nike)
- [Social Media](https://kennethnathanael.com/work/social-media): post systems, launches, ads and reels for food, retail and lifestyle brands
- [Branding](https://kennethnathanael.com/work/branding): identities, packaging and campaign visuals for consumer brands
- [Web + UI](https://kennethnathanael.com/work/web-ui): websites and product screens
- [Print + Info](https://kennethnathanael.com/work/print-info): information graphics and print
- [Motion](https://kennethnathanael.com/work/motion): motion graphics and video
